description: Big banner letters from text, using the website's own bitmap fonts: block (█ 5×7), char (any fill character, e.g. #), shadow (█ with ░ shade), compact (half-block 5×7), small (█ 3×5), tiny (half-block 3×5). Letters A-Z, digits and common punctuation (unknown characters show as "?"); one banner per input line. Returns the text; format "png" also renders it to banner.png. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/ascii-art/

output.description: Where to write the result: a file path, or a folder ending in "/". Default: the server output folder (a temp folder unless --out-dir is set).

text.description: Text to render (case-insensitive). New lines make separate banners.

theme.description: PNG colours: dark (teal on near-black, default) or light.

name: image_ascii_banner
title: Text to ASCII banner
